domain_shape_extension: In addition to generic AST features, classify vectorized logical/domain combinators such as where, not_, and_, or_, min_, max_, astype and entity/parameter calls.
methodological_rule: Only evidence co-located with the candidate ID inside one structured historical record may create a new authoritative mapping. Global unions of candidate evidence are diagnostic only.
name_filter_rule: Boolean-like tokens and 64-hex digests are not treated as function names.
